Respondent/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Upendra Kumar Singh, Advocate

For the Respondent/s : Mr. Sajid Salim Khan (SC-25)
 ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 5 12-02-2024 Heard Mr. Neeraj Kumar, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners and learned AC to SC-25.
2.

The present petition has been preferred for following reliefs:
(i) to quash the notice dated 29.06.2019 issued under signature of District Magistrate (collector), Bhojpur under section 30 of Right to Fair compensation and Patna High Surendra Kumar Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 12 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187679034/
1 Court CWJC No.5089 of 2020(5) dt.12-02-2024 Transparency in land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 by which the petitioners have been asked to receive the compensation amount without hearing the petitioners.

entities.text: Patna High Surendra Kumar Singh vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: (ii) To quash the notice dated-29.8.2019 & 26.12.2019 issued under signature of District Magistrate (Collector) & District Land Acquisition Officer, Bhojpur respectively under section 37(2) of Right to Fair Compensation and transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: (iii) To stop the proceeding of L.A. Case no. 06/2011-2012 and no. 49/2012-1013 which has been initiated by the Respondent authority.
(iv) To quash the notice section 4 Act 1 of 1964 issued in name of petitioners' grandfather in connection with LA Case no. 49/2012-2013.
() To direct the respondents authority not to construct the police station on the petitioners' land.
(vi) To direct the respondent's authority not to construct the police station in middle of village in the interest of justice without assessment of social impact as provided in law/ Act.

(vii) To direct the Respondents authority to Patna High Court CWJC No.5089 of 2020(5)
dt.12-02-2024 release the land in question from the Acquisition and to further direct them to construct the police station building on Government land which is available on main Road, in same village.
(viii) For any other relief(s) for which the petitioners are found entitled in the facts and circumstances of the case.

3. It is unfortunate that the case is of year 2020 and still no reply on behalf of the respondents,
specially the respondent No. 06, the District Magistrate-cum-Collector, Bhojpur is on record.
4.

Learned State counsel submits that the filing is of the period of Covid-19 and as such, there has been delay.
5.
Such submission is fit to be rejected as Covid-19 has disappeared in the May 2022 itself.

6. As a last chance, list this case after four weeks enabling the State counsel to file counter-affidavit on behalf of the respondent failing which a cost of Rs. 5,000/- shall be deposited with the Patna High Court Legal Services Committee.
(Rajiv Roy, J) Adnan/-
